title: Executable Engineering Knowledge System Completion
purpose: Complete AEKS with safely executable, licensed, attributable and evidence-producing engineering knowledge.
scope: Admission, licenses, provenance, declarative expressions, AST allowlist, exact inputs, validation rules, units, hashes and professional review boundaries.

requirements.title: Knowledge admission
requirements.statement: Approved executable knowledge shall include license, provenance, deterministic mode and review boundary.
requirements.rationale: Protect lawful and safe knowledge use.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Safe execution
requirements.statement: The executor shall allow arithmetic and comparisons while rejecting calls, attributes and unknown names.
requirements.rationale: Prevent knowledge payloads from executing arbitrary code.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Input contract
requirements.statement: Inputs shall exactly match declared names, be finite and pass validation rules.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Execution evidence
requirements.statement: Results shall record knowledge version, units, jurisdiction, review status and integrity hashes.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Immediate consumer
requirements.statement: A reference bearing-pressure EKU shall execute through the new boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

requirements.title: Reproducible delivery
requirements.statement: AEKS alignment shall include tests, documentation, installer, manifest, checksums and release.
acceptance_criteria: Implementation exists or is formally planned.

risks: Generated engineering output requires human review.
